name: deep-research-plugin
description: Evidence-first research with Official, Mixed, and Deep Discovery modes, claim verification, and APA 7 citations.

interface.longDescription: Research with authoritative evidence, cross-checked community findings, or broad public-web discovery. Defaults to APA 7 citations and explicit uncertainty labels.
defaultPrompt: Use Deep Research Engine to investigate this claim and trace it to the strongest available evidence.
Use Deep Research Engine in Official mode to research this topic with authoritative sources.
Use Deep Research Engine in Deep Discovery mode to investigate this obscure topic and classify what is verified and unknown.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.0 sets standard effort for broad questions and adds current-news chronology, claim-source checks, and causal-uncertainty reporting.
